title: Committed Vector State After a Later Abort: A Bounded Lightfoot Audit
author: Ezekiel Ologunde
scope: Two file-backed deferred-save storage controls show vector rollback despite correct SQL rows; four flush/in-memory controls preserve state. Native retrieval uses deterministic injected embeddings: all 16 post-deletion query observations exclude retired text and final-ranked retired IDs while preserving survivor context. No deleted-text disclosure or learned-model efficacy claim.
replay_scope: The exact 42-member archive was replayed from a clean extraction; all three commands exited zero and scientific outcomes matched. Timing, timestamp-bearing NPZ container byte hashes and the dependent receipt hash are excluded from comparison; vector values, row content, identifiers, graph fingerprints and context are compared.
